tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH/MCHC), which may be age-related or secondary to chronic disease. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, possibly indicating increased platelet size variability, which can be seen in reactive states. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation is recommended.
